dedupe_keys.name: the 2023 national seismic hazard assessment for australia model input and output data

description: The 2023 National Seismic Hazard Assessment for Australia: Model Input and Output Data is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This Geoscience Australia Record contains technical data and input files that, when used with the Global Earthquake Model’s (GEM’s) OpenQuake-engine probabilistic seismic hazard analysis software (Pagani et al., 2023), will enable end users to explore and reproduce the 2023 National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA23) of Australia (Allen et al., 2023b). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are 2023 National Seismic Hazard Assessment - NSHA 2023, HVC_144647, Published_External, Seismology and Seismic Exploration, earthquake hazard. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
